法人指出，從台股連假期間國際表現震盪整理觀察，目前台股多空續作拉鋸互不相讓，從技術面上觀察，盤面仍屬輪漲結構不變，仍在季線上下整理，短線指數以震盪保守看待；從外資籌碼觀察，外資現貨賣超81億，期貨淨空單縮減至86,043口，並無明顯多空布局。

items.title: 〈旺宏法說〉不再擴產NOR Flash 新產能全力衝刺eMMC、3D NAND
items.title_en: Winstar Says No More NOR Flash Expansion; New Capacity Focused on eMMC and 3D NAND
paras: 旺宏(2337-TW)今(27)日召開法說會，董事長吳敏求表示，將加速調整產品布局，eMMC供貨約一年多來，成長相當驚人，旺宏不會再增加NOR Flash產能，未來新增產能將用在eMMC和NAND，NOR Flash則不再擴產。
對於同業收購NOR產能，吳敏求表示，有競爭是好事，大家各憑本事做不同的技術。他指出，國內多數公司喜歡做me-too的產品，花錢買了東西就可以用，旺宏則是要創造新的想法和應用。
吳敏求強調，「旺宏is not a me-too company」，旺宏很小，不可能和三星、SK海力士、美光正面競爭，也不會拚命降價搶市場，而是要做出差異化產品，國內有「護國神山」，旺宏做不到，所以要有幾座「護民神山」，旺宏大概是全球醫療領域最大的Flash供應商。
產能策略上，吳敏求表示，旺宏不會再增加NOR Flash產能，新產能將用在eMMC和NAND，尤其3D NAND產能會大幅成長，有很重要的客戶一直追著要貨；至於NOR出貨量季減12%，並非因需求放緩，而是產能有限，因此調配產能生產NAND，有限的NOR產能會用在太空通訊、資料中心和醫療等高附加價值應用領域。
從新產品進度來看，吳敏求表示，明年將以96層3D NAND作為eMMC NAND的生產主力，良率不錯，獲利能力比2D產品好很多，大公司淡出低容量NAND後，旺宏有很好的機會，但產能有限，不可能接下所有客戶。
談及長約議題，吳敏求表示，不曉得長約對供應商有什麼好處，若要簽長約，只有在互利、公平的情況下才會簽。對於漲價，他則說，漲價和需求有關，每一個產品都可以漲價，只要找到對的客戶，合約價上漲是必然的。
擴產時程方面，吳敏求表示，第一階段投資設備今年已開始進廠，經過驗證後，真正量產要到明年下半年，後續追加的投資，設備可能要到明年下半年或年底才能進廠，量產可能落在2028年。
paras_en: Winstar (2337‑TW) held an investor briefing today (27th). Chairman Wu Min‑chiu said the company will accelerate its product‑mix adjustment. After more than a year of remarkable growth in eMMC supply, Winstar will not add any more NOR Flash capacity; any new capacity will be devoted to eMMC and NAND, and NOR Flash production will not be expanded further.

Regarding competitors’ acquisitions of NOR capacity, Wu said competition is healthy and each player should rely on its own strengths and different technologies. He noted that most domestic firms prefer me‑too products—buying something and using it as‑is—whereas Winstar aims to create new ideas and applications.

Wu stressed, “Winstar is not a me‑too company.” Winstar is small and cannot directly compete with Samsung, SK Hynix or Micron, nor will it engage in a price‑war to win market share. Instead, it seeks differentiated products. While the domestic market has a “national‑protecting mountain,” Winstar cannot match that, so it must build its own “people‑protecting mountains.” Winstar is roughly the world’s largest Flash supplier to the medical sector.

On capacity strategy, Wu reiterated that Winstar will not increase NOR Flash capacity. New capacity will go to eMMC and NAND, especially a substantial boost in 3D NAND, driven by a key customer’s strong demand. The 12% quarterly drop in NOR shipments is not due to weak demand but limited capacity; the company is reallocating capacity to NAND, and the limited NOR output will be reserved for high‑value‑add applications such as space communications, data centers and medical devices.

Regarding product road‑map, Wu said that next year the company will use 96‑layer 3D NAND as the main production base for eMMC NAND. Yields are good and profitability is far better than 2D products. With large players exiting low‑capacity NAND, Winstar has a strong opportunity, though limited capacity means it cannot serve every customer.

On long‑term contracts, Wu said he does not see clear benefits for suppliers and would only sign such agreements if they are mutually beneficial and fair. As for price increases, he explained that they are linked to demand; any product can be priced higher as long as the right customers are found, making contract price hikes inevitable.

Regarding expansion timing, Wu noted that the first‑phase equipment investment started arriving this year. After validation, mass production is expected in the second half of next year. Subsequent investment equipment may not arrive until the second half or end of next year, with full‑scale production possibly pushed to 2028.

items.title: 台灣大林之晨：收購精誠信心十足 公開收購時程不再延後
items.title_en: Taiwan Mobile's Lin Zhi-Chen: Confident in Jingcheng Acquisition, No Further Delay to Tender Period
paras: 台灣大(3045-TW)旗下台信電訊收購精誠資訊(6214-TW)一案，公平交易委員會日前決議不禁止結合，總經理林之晨今(27)日指出，在公平會完成審議後，相關不確定風險消失，因此目前對於收購進展「高度、十足信心」，公開收購期間至11月5日下午3時30分，不會再延後。
台灣大旗下台信電訊收購精誠資訊普通股，公平會決議不禁止此案結合。此案目前尚待有效應賣股數達106,174,796股、約占精誠資訊已發行股份 39%的成就條件，最高預定收購157,900,979 股、約占58%。精誠股東可於11月5日下午3時30分前參與應賣，其餘收購條件均維持不變。
公平會通過審議後，精誠股價又有一波漲勢。對此，林之晨則表示，市場知道不確定性因素已經消除，認為這是公開收購會有的正常反應。
台灣大今天盤中衝上135元創新天價，中華電信(2412-TW)與遠傳(4904-TW)近日股價也頻頻創高，林之晨認為有幾個因素，包括市場意識到AI算力需要網路，電信族群成為AI蓬勃發展的受益者；第二則是最近製造業股價有一波修正，市場回頭發現電信族群「守中帶攻」，股價相對抗跌，過去1年漲幅達2至3成。
蘋果(AAPL-US)首款摺疊手機iPhone Duo開賣，針對銷售情況，林之晨指出，銷售狀況良好，不過訂單數為到貨量的好幾倍，整體仍缺貨。台灣大也觀察，開賣至26日的銷售數據，月租1599元(含)以上方案申辦較iPhone 18 Pro比重提升近1成，反映高階摺疊旗艦帶動果粉資費升級需求。
此外，台灣大「大哥付你分期」先買後付應用場景持續拓展，今日也攜手可樂旅遊、寵物公園、藍新金流、Petscare崴聖科技及台灣牙易通共5大合作夥伴，分享跨產業應用成果，從電商購物延伸至旅遊、美業與寵物照護等生活服務，截至今年9月底，累計用戶數年增達49.9%。
paras_en: Taiwan Mobile (3045-TW) subsidiary Taiwan Telecom's acquisition of Jingcheng Information (6214-TW) was recently cleared by the Fair Trade Commission, which decided not to prohibit the combination. General Manager Lin Zhi-Chen said on the 27th that once the commission completes its review, the related uncertainties disappear, so the company is now "highly and fully confident" about the acquisition progress. The public tender period will run until 3:30 p.m. on November 5 and will not be extended further.

Taiwan Telecom’s purchase of Jingcheng Information’s common shares has been cleared by the Fair Trade Commission. The deal still requires the sale of at least 106,174,796 shares – about 39% of Jingcheng’s outstanding shares – to be effective, with a maximum planned acquisition of 157,900,979 shares, roughly 58%. Jingcheng shareholders may tender their shares until 3:30 p.m. on November 5, and all other acquisition terms remain unchanged.

After the commission’s approval, Jingcheng’s share price surged again. Lin said the market now knows the uncertainty factor has been removed and that this price reaction is a normal response to a public tender.

Taiwan Mobile’s stock surged to a record high of NT$135 intraday, while Chunghwa Telecom (2412‑TW) and Far EasTone (4904‑TW) have also been hitting fresh highs recently. Lin attributed this to several factors: the market’s recognition that AI computing power needs network infrastructure, making telecom groups beneficiaries of AI growth; and a recent correction in manufacturing stocks that led investors to view telecoms as “defensive with upside,” allowing them to outperform, with a 20‑30% gain over the past year.

Apple’s first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, has launched. Lin noted that sales are strong, but orders are several times the actual shipments, leaving the product still in short supply. Taiwan Mobile observed that, as of the 26th, subscription plans priced at NT$1,599 or higher have risen by about 10 percentage points compared with the iPhone 18 Pro, indicating that the high‑end foldable flagship is driving Apple fans to upgrade their plans.

In addition, Taiwan Mobile’s “Big Brother Pay‑You‑Installments” buy‑now‑pay‑later service continues to expand its use cases. Today it partnered with five firms – Cola Travel, Pet Park, Blue New Payments, Petscare, and Taiwan Dental‑Easy – to showcase cross‑industry applications ranging from e‑commerce to travel, beauty services and pet care. By the end of September this year, the cumulative user base had grown 49.9% year‑over‑year.

items.title: 〈財報〉國防業務成長也難補！波音Q3商用飛機虧損超預期 增產還卡關
items.title_en: Earnings: Defense Growth Still Can't Fill the Gap! Boeing Q3 Commercial Aircraft Losses Exceed Expectations, Production Ramp‑Up Stalled
paras: 波音(BA-US)周二(27日)美股盤前公布2026會計年度第三季(截至9/30)財報，國防業務成長帶動整體虧損較去年大幅收斂，營收與自由現金流也優於預期，但商用飛機交付幾乎停滯，加上增產與供應鏈成本攀升，導致核心商用飛機部門虧損超出預期，凸顯這家航太巨擘的復甦之路仍面臨挑戰。
截稿前，波音周二盤前股價小漲0.37%，每股暫報189美元，稍早一度上漲1.4%。該股今年以來累計下跌約13%，若此走勢延續至年底，全年表現將是近5年來次差。
根據財報，波音第三季營收年增4%至241.9億美元，高於市場預估的238.4億美元；淨損1.16億美元，每股虧損0.26美元，較去年同期淨損53.4億美元明顯改善。不過，調整後每股虧損0.34美元，仍遜於分析師預估的虧損0.21美元。
去年同期波音曾因延宕的777X計畫認列約49億美元費用，使虧損基期偏高。本季自由現金流則達4.64億美元，高於去年同期的2.38億美元，也超過市場預估的3.251億美元。

商用飛機虧損超標 增產仍受阻

波音第三季交付161架商用飛機，僅比去年同期多1架。商用飛機部門營收年減3%至107.2億美元，營業虧損6.97億美元，遠高於分析師預估的3.608億美元，營業利益率為負6.5%。
公司表示，交付機型組合較不利、未來調整產能所需的預估成本提高，以及供應鏈成本增加，均拖累部門表現。
波音仍努力讓737 MAX月產量穩定在47架，增產進度慢於預期，機翼製造與引擎供應都是限制因素。787目前月產約8架，公司先前也坦言，引擎交付尚不足以支撐月產10架的目標。
飛機交付是改善財務的關鍵，因為客戶通常在收機時支付大部分款項。波音重申，預計明年開始交付777-9，較原定時程晚約6年，並計劃明年進一步提高737 MAX產量。

國防業務支撐復甦 債務壓力仍在

國防與太空部門第三季營收年增15%至79.4億美元，受惠全球國防支出增加帶動交付成長，加上營運改善及出售共同持有逾20年的HRL Laboratories所帶來的助益，營業獲利接近5億美元，營業利益率由去年同期的1.7%升至6.2%。全球服務部門營業獲利則達10億美元。
波音近期也取得進展，包括拿下美國海軍第六代F/A-XX戰機合約，以及737 MAX 7、MAX 10陸續獲美國監管機關認證。
季末總債務維持459億美元，淨債務則由前季259億美元降至252億美元，另有100億美元未動用授信額度。
執行長奧特伯格(Kelly Ortberg)表示，公司基礎比一年前更穩固，但仍須改善效率、落實訂單交付，並在維持安全與品質的同時提升日常營運表現。
paras_en: Boeing (BA-US) on Tuesday (the 27th) released its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter earnings (ended September 30) before the U.S. market opened. Growth in the defense segment helped narrow the overall loss sharply versus last year, and revenue and free cash flow beat forecasts, but commercial‑aircraft deliveries were almost flat. Rising production costs and supply‑chain expenses pushed the core commercial‑aircraft division’s loss beyond expectations, underscoring that the aerospace giant’s recovery path still faces hurdles.

Ahead of the market close on Tuesday, Boeing’s pre‑market share rose modestly 0.37% to $189 per share after briefly climbing 1.4% earlier. The stock is down about 13% year‑to‑date; if that trend continues through year‑end, its annual performance would be the worst in nearly five years.

According to the filing, Boeing’s third‑quarter revenue grew 4% year‑over‑year to $24.19 billion, topping analysts’ estimate of $23.84 billion. Net loss was $1.16 billion, or $0.26 per share, a marked improvement from the $5.34 billion loss a year earlier. However, adjusted loss per share was $0.34, still worse than the consensus forecast of a $0.21 loss.

Last year Boeing booked roughly $4.9 billion of charges tied to delays in the 777X program, inflating the prior‑year loss base. This quarter’s free cash flow reached $464 million, up from $238 million a year earlier and above the $325.1 million analysts expected.

Commercial‑aircraft losses blew past expectations and production gains remain constrained. Boeing delivered 161 commercial jets in the quarter, just one more than the same period last year. Commercial‑aircraft revenue fell 3% to $10.72 billion, while operating loss widened to $697 million, far exceeding analysts’ $360.8 million estimate, and operating margin turned negative 6.5%.
The company said an unfavorable mix of delivered models, higher estimated costs to adjust capacity, and rising supply‑chain expenses all weighed on the segment’s performance.

Boeing is still working to keep 737 MAX monthly output steady at 47 aircraft, but the ramp‑up is slower than hoped, with wing‑building and engine supply acting as bottlenecks. The 787 is currently produced at about eight units per month, and the firm has previously admitted that engine deliveries are insufficient to support a target of ten per month.

Aircraft deliveries are key to improving finances because customers typically pay most of the price upon receipt. Boeing reiterated that it expects to start delivering the 777‑9 next year, roughly six years later than originally planned, and it aims to further increase 737 MAX output next year.

Defense and space revenue rose 15% year‑over‑year to $7.94 billion, helped by higher global defense spending and stronger delivery growth, as well as operational improvements and proceeds from the sale of its more‑than‑20‑year‑held stake in HRL Laboratories. Operating profit approached $500 million, with operating margin climbing from 1.7% a year ago to 6.2%. Global services generated $1 billion in operating profit.
Boeing has also made recent strides, securing a U.S. Navy sixth‑generation F/A‑XX fighter contract and obtaining U.S. regulator approvals for the 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 variants.
Quarter‑end total debt stayed at $45.9 billion, while net debt fell from $25.9 billion in the prior quarter to $25.2 billion, and $10 billion of credit remains undrawn.

CEO Kelly Ortberg said the company’s foundation is stronger than a year ago, but it still needs to boost efficiency, execute order deliveries, and improve day‑to‑day operations while maintaining safety and quality.

items.title: 老牌車廠也要科技味！通用汽車告別紐約證交所 轉投那斯達克
items.title_en: Legacy Automaker Goes High-Tech: General Motors Leaves NYSE for Nasdaq
paras: 通用汽車(GM-US)周二(27日)宣布，計劃將股票上市地點由紐約證交所轉至那斯達克全球精選市場，預計11月17日起在新交易所掛牌，股票代號維持「GM」。這家美國老牌車廠正積極發展自動駕駛、人工智慧(AI)與電動車，藉此強化科技企業定位，轉板也將使其具備未來納入那斯達克100指數的資格。
消息公布後，通用汽車股價在紐約周二盤前上漲約2.4%。公司表示，現有股東無須針對這次上市地點轉移採取任何行動。
綜合《彭博》與《CNBC》報導，通用汽車財務長賈各森(Paul Jacobson)表示，公司以客戶為核心、科技為驅動的策略，正為股東創造價值，隨著業務成長，那斯達克自然成為適合的上市地點。他也感謝紐約證交所長期以來的合作，並肯定其深厚歷史。
這項決定延續了通用汽車近期凸顯科技實力的布局。公司上周才舉辦一場以科技為主題的活動，由高層說明AI與自動駕駛技術發展藍圖。如今選擇轉往科技股集中的那斯達克掛牌，進一步呼應其希望市場以科技轉型角度看待公司的方向。
除了企業形象，指數納入機會也是這次轉板的重點。通用汽車指出，轉至那斯達克後，公司將具備未來納入那斯達克100指數的資格，但這並不代表轉板後就會自動成為指數成分股。
對紐約證交所而言，通用汽車離開是一項具象徵意義的損失。通用汽車早在1911年便於該交易所上市，之後歷經政府支持的破產重整，並於2010年重返紐約證交所掛牌，雙方淵源跨越逾一個世紀。
近年已有多家大型企業由紐約證交所轉往那斯達克，包括沃爾瑪(WMT-US)、DoorDash(DASH-US)與Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)。希爾頓全球控股(HLT-US)也在上周宣布，計劃將股票交易地點由紐約證交所轉至那斯達克。
各家企業轉板的考量並不相同。那斯達克(NDAQ-US)曾於2024年指出，常見因素包括爭取納入指數的機會、具成本效益的收費結構、協助提升品牌能見度的合作，以及使用那斯達克活動空間、投資人關係與環境、社會及公司治理(ESG)相關產品。
通用汽車近年也積極買回股票，自2024年以來股價已上漲逾一倍。該股周一收在每股76.31美元，公司市值約644億美元。
paras_en: General Motors (GM-US) announced on Tuesday the 27th that it plans to move its listing from the New York Stock Exchange to the Nasdaq Global Select Market, with the new listing expected to begin on November 17 and the ticker remaining "GM". The veteran U.S. automaker is actively developing autonomous driving, artificial intelligence (AI) and electric vehicles to strengthen its identity as a technology company, and the move will also make it eligible for future inclusion in the Nasdaq‑100 index.

After the announcement, GM shares rose about 2.4% in pre‑market trading on Tuesday in New York. The company said existing shareholders do not need to take any action regarding the relocation of the listing.

According to Bloomberg and CNBC, GM Chief Financial Officer Paul Jacobson said the company’s customer‑centric, technology‑driven strategy is creating value for shareholders and, as the business grows, Nasdaq naturally becomes the appropriate venue. He thanked the NYSE for its long‑standing cooperation and acknowledged its deep history.

The decision continues GM’s recent push to showcase its tech capabilities. The company held a technology‑focused event last week where senior executives outlined its AI and autonomous‑driving roadmap. Moving to the tech‑heavy Nasdaq reinforces its desire for the market to view the firm through a technology‑transformation lens.

Beyond branding, the prospect of index inclusion is a key driver of the move. GM noted that after shifting to Nasdaq it will be eligible for future inclusion in the Nasdaq‑100, though the change does not automatically make it a component of the index.

For the NYSE, GM’s departure is a symbolically significant loss. GM first listed on the exchange in 1911, later underwent a government‑backed bankruptcy restructuring, and returned to the NYSE in 2010, a relationship spanning more than a century.

In recent years several large companies have moved from the NYSE to Nasdaq, including Walmart (WMT‑US), DoorDash (DASH‑US) and Palantir Technologies (PLTR‑US). Hilton Worldwide Holdings (HLT‑US) also announced last week that it plans to shift its listing from the NYSE to Nasdaq.

Each company’s reasons for switching differ. Nasdaq (NDAQ‑US) indicated in 2024 that common factors include the chance to join an index, a cost‑effective fee structure, branding visibility support, and access to Nasdaq’s event spaces, investor‑relations services and ESG‑related products.

GM has also been actively buying back shares in recent years; its stock has more than doubled since 2024. The shares closed on Monday at $76.31 each, giving the company a market value of roughly $64.4 billion.

items.title: 輝達擬投資Meta 30億美元，擴大Muse AI代理與晶片部署合作
items.title_en: Nvidia Plans $3 B Investment in Meta, Expanding Muse AI Agent and Chip Deployment Collaboration
paras: 2026年10月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 輝達(NVDA-US)與Meta(META-US)宣布擴大Muse AI代理及模型合作，將共同改善模型訓練與推論效能。輝達並宣布，將在Meta此次股權發行中投資30億美元（約新台幣974億元）；Meta則計畫擴大輝達運算與網路設備的部署，支援下一代AI代理服務。
這次合作延伸自Meta既有的輝達基礎設施。雙方表示，將針對模型運作流程進行最佳化，提升效能並降低整體使用成本。Meta計畫擴大部署Vera Rubin平台與Vera處理器，也將採用Spectrum-X乙太網路及BlueField-4，以改善資料中心網路效率與資料傳輸能力。
合作範圍也可能延伸至AI代理的安全管理。雙方正考慮採用輝達OpenShell參考架構，協助安全部署AI代理，並透過Sentry監測代理行為。
Meta在10月26日公布籌資規劃時，輝達、AMD與博通僅表達非約束性的認購意向；此次輝達進一步公布自己的投資金額，並與Meta擴大技術合作。投資仍須符合相關交割條件。

paras_en: October 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Meta (META-US) announced an expanded Muse AI agent and model partnership to jointly improve model training and inference performance. Nvidia also said it will invest $3 billion (about NT$97.4 billion) in Meta’s current equity offering; Meta plans to broaden deployment of Nvidia computing and networking equipment to support next‑generation AI agent services.

The collaboration builds on Meta’s existing Nvidia infrastructure. Both parties said they will optimize the model operation workflow to boost efficiency and lower overall usage costs. Meta plans to expand deployment of the Vera Rubin platform and Vera processors, and will also adopt Spectrum‑X Ethernet and BlueField‑4 to improve data‑center network efficiency and data transfer capability.

The scope of cooperation may also extend to AI agent security management. Both sides are considering using Nvidia’s OpenShell reference architecture to help securely deploy AI agents and to monitor agent behavior through Sentry.

When Meta disclosed its fundraising plan on October 26, Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom only expressed non‑binding subscription intentions; Nvidia now further disclosed its investment amount and is expanding technical cooperation with Meta. The investment remains subject to applicable closing conditions.

items.title: Anthropic IPO治理架構曝光！7名共同創辦人掌握50.1%投票權 外部股東難左右決策
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Governance Structure Exposed! Seven Co‑Founders Hold 50.1% Voting Power, External Shareholders Find It Hard to Influence Decisions
paras: 有意投資Anthropic的人最好做好心理準備，因為這家AI公司的七名共同創辦人將牢牢掌握公司的決策主導權，代表隨著Anthropic朝市值超過1兆美元的目標邁進，投資人將不得不信任這群規模不大的AI工程師與研究人員。
Anthropic周一(26日)在IPO公開說明書中表示，阿莫戴兄妹——Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei與總裁Daniela Amodei這，以及另外五名共同創辦人，將成為新設實體「Founder LLC」的唯一成員，該實體將掌握Anthropic已發行股份50.1%的投票權。
根據Anthropic，這項架構將使共同創辦人在可預見的未來，能夠「決定提交股東表決一般事項的結果」。換句話說，這個架構也將限制機構投資人與散戶的權力及影響力。
Anthropic長期致力於建立比其他AI研究機構更重視安全的形象，並設計了一套治理架構，讓共同創辦人即使進入每季需公布財報的上市公司環境，仍能維護公司的長期使命。
Anthropic在申報文件中說：「我們的治理架構可能降低公司遭遇非主動合併提案、非主動公開收購要約，或以委託書徵求方式推動撤換董事的可能性。因此，這套治理架構可能提高更換董事與管理階層的難度，也可能使股東失去以高於當前市場價格出售股票的機會。」
Anthropic將這套制度形容為一種「新穎的資本與公司治理架構」，並指出，這種架構「在上市公司中沒有直接的先例」。

創辦人掌握投票權 投資人須接受長期治理安排

CNBC指出，對投資人而言，這是研讀Anthropic公開說明書時必須考量的另一層複雜因素。這份文件包含超過90頁的風險因素，Anthropic列出的潛在風險包括政治挑戰、資料中心設置禁令，以及如何在安全與商業目標之間取得平衡。
對部分投資人來說，創辦人掌握控制權，是具有世代影響力的科技企業的重要特徵。
Bessemer Venture Partners合夥人Byron Deeter表示，當企業擁有優秀的領導團隊，投資人往往願意讓早期管理階層與創辦人在公司上市後，仍保有治理權。
Bessemer曾以140億美元估值投資Anthropic，以成本基礎計算後，是該公司116年歷史上規模最大的一筆投資。
Deeter周一說：「當你面對的是足以定義產品類別、甚至改變整個產業的機會時，你會希望團隊能夠著眼長期。這種做法有許多好處，能讓團隊專注於真正的創新，而不是只看每個月，甚至每一季的表現。」
除了阿莫戴兄妹，Anthropic創辦團隊還包括：技術長Tom Brown(負責運算資源)、Anthropic Institute負責人Jack Clark、首席科學長Jared Kaplan、首席架構師Sam McCandlish，以及負責可解釋性研究的Christopher Olah。

「公益公司」架構搭配信託 共同決定董事會人選

Anthropic依德拉瓦州法律註冊為「公益公司」(Public Benefit Corporation)，這代表公司必須在股東的財務利益、受公司行為影響者的最佳利益，以及公司宗旨之間取得平衡。而Anthropic的公司宗旨正是促進「以人類長期福祉為目標，負責任地開發及維護先進人工智慧」。
此外，Anthropic於2023年設立獨立治理機構「長期利益信託」(Long-Term Benefit Trust，LTBT)，由該信託負責選任及撤換公司董事會的多數成員。
根據公開說明書，LTBT將透過一種特殊類別的普通股，即T類普通股，行使這項權力。這類股票「在提交一般股東表決的事項上，不具備其他投票權」。
LTBT目前的受託人包括實驗物理學家Christopher Stubbs、美國聯準會(Fed)前主席柏南克(Ben Bernanke)、柯林頓健康獲取倡議組織(Clinton Health Access Initiative)執行長Neil Buddy Shah，以及國家安全專家Richard Fontaine。
根據申報文件，所有受託人與Anthropic之間都不存在財務利益關係。
根據那斯達克全球精選市場的公司治理規定，由於LTBT有權選任董事會多數成員，Anthropic將被視為「受控制公司」。Anthropic計劃以股票代號「ANT」在那斯達克掛牌上市。
今年6月以史上最大規模IPO上市的SpaceX(SPCX-US)，也被列為受控制公司，原因是執行長馬斯克仍掌握多數投票權。
Anthropic共同創辦人則將透過Founder LLC的身分，負責選任董事會其餘成員。該公司周一表示，相信共同創辦人「特別適合成為公司使命的守護者」。
Anthropic指出，Founder LLC與LTBT掌握的投票權，並非根據其在公司的經濟利益決定，也不會因稀釋或其他因素而減少。該公司說，在可預見的未來，這套資本結構將持續把投票權集中在這兩個實體手中。
Anthropic在文件中也提醒：「此外，LTBT、Founder LLC及個別共同創辦人的利益可能與你們不同，他們可能投下你們不認同、甚至有損你們利益的選票。」
paras_en: Potential investors in Anthropic should prepare mentally, as the seven co‑founders of this AI company will firmly control the company’s decision‑making. This means that as Anthropic moves toward a market cap of over $1 trillion, investors will have to trust this small group of AI engineers and researchers.

On Monday (26th), Anthropic disclosed in its IPO prospectus that the Amodei siblings—CEO Dario Amodei and President Daniela Amodei—along with five other co‑founders, will become the sole members of a newly created entity called Founder LLC, which will hold 50.1% of the voting rights of Anthropic’s issued shares.

According to Anthropic, this structure will allow the co‑founders to "decide the outcome of shareholder votes on ordinary matters" in the foreseeable future. In other words, the structure also limits the power and influence of institutional investors and retail shareholders.

Anthropic has long aimed to build an image of being more safety‑focused than other AI research institutions, and has designed a governance framework that lets the co‑founders maintain the company’s long‑term mission even when the company becomes a quarterly reporting public entity.

Anthropic states in its filing: "Our governance structure may reduce the likelihood of unsolicited merger proposals, unsolicited takeover offers, or proxy‑driven board changes. Therefore, this governance structure may increase the difficulty of replacing directors and management, and may also deprive shareholders of the opportunity to sell shares above the current market price."
Anthropic describes this system as a "novel capital and corporate governance structure" and notes that such an arrangement "has no direct precedent in public companies."

Founder control of voting rights forces investors to accept long‑term governance arrangements. CNBC points out that for investors, this is another layer of complexity to consider when studying Anthropic’s prospectus. The document contains over 90 pages of risk factors, including political challenges, data‑center bans, and how to balance safety with commercial goals.
For some investors, founder control is a hallmark of a generationally impactful tech company.

Byron Deeter, partner at Bessemer Venture Partners, said that when a company has an excellent leadership team, investors are often willing to let early management and founders retain governance rights after the company goes public.
Bessemer invested in Anthropic at a $14 billion valuation, which, on a cost basis, is the largest investment in the company’s 116‑year history.

Deeter said on Monday: "When you’re facing an opportunity that can define a product category or even change an entire industry, you want the team to focus on the long term. That approach has many benefits, allowing the team to concentrate on true innovation rather than just monthly or quarterly performance."

In addition to the Amodei siblings, Anthropic’s founding team includes CTO Tom Brown (responsible for compute resources), Jack Clark (head of the Anthropic Institute), Chief Scientific Officer Jared Kaplan, Chief Architect Sam McCandlish, and Christopher Olah, who leads explainability research.

The "public benefit company" structure paired with a trust jointly decides board appointments. Anthropic is registered in Delaware as a Public Benefit Corporation, meaning the company must balance shareholders’ financial interests, the best interests of those affected by the company’s actions, and the company’s purpose, which is to promote responsible development and maintenance of advanced artificial intelligence for humanity’s long‑term welfare.
In 2023, Anthropic established an independent governance body called the Long‑Term Benefit Trust (LTBT), which is responsible for appointing and removing the majority of the company’s board members.

According to the prospectus, the LTBT will exercise this power through a special class of common stock, Class‑T common shares, which "do not have voting rights on matters submitted to ordinary shareholder votes."

The LTBT’s current trustees include experimental physicist Christopher Stubbs, former Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke, Neil Buddy Shah, CEO of the Clinton Health Access Initiative, and national security expert Richard Fontaine.
The filing states that none of the trustees have a financial interest in Anthropic, and there is no financial relationship between them and the company.

Under Nasdaq Global Select Market governance rules, because the LTBT has the right to appoint the majority of the board, Anthropic will be classified as a "controlled company." Anthropic plans to list on Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT."
SpaceX (SPCX‑US), which had the largest IPO ever in June, is also classified as a controlled company because CEO Elon Musk still holds the majority of voting rights.

Anthropic co‑founders will, through Founder LLC, be responsible for appointing the remaining board members. The company said on Monday that it believes the co‑founders are "particularly well‑suited to be guardians of the company’s mission."

Anthropic notes that the voting power held by Founder LLC and LTBT is not determined by their economic interest in the company, nor will it be diluted or otherwise reduced. The company says that in the foreseeable future, this capital structure will continue to concentrate voting power in these two entities.

Anthropic also warns in the filing: "Furthermore, the interests of the LTBT, Founder LLC, and individual co‑founders may differ from yours, and they may cast votes that you do not agree with or that may even harm your interests."

items.title: 應用材料加碼投資貝思半導體！持股升至20%、深化AI先進封裝合作
items.title_en: Applied Materials Increases Investment in BE Semiconductor to 20% and Deepens AI Advanced Packaging Collaboration
paras: 美國半導體設備商應用材料(AMAT-US) 週一（26日）宣布，計畫將持有荷蘭半導體設備商貝思半導體（BE Semiconductor Industries）的股權比例，從目前的9%提高至約20%，，進一步深化雙方在人工智慧（AI）應用所需先進晶片封裝技術方面的合作。
根據《路透》報導，應用材料表示，已就增持這家半導體設備製造商的股份簽署加速股份購買協議，但交易須接受美國反壟斷審查。
應用材料自2025年4月取得貝思半導體9%股權後，成為該公司最大股東。
雙方擴大合作後，將聚焦新型晶片連接與封裝技術，致力於支援新一代AI半導體。
應用材料指出，目前並無計畫將持股比例提高至約20%以上，也不打算爭取貝思半導體董事會席次。
兩家公司自2020年起便合作開發混合鍵合（hybrid bonding）技術。這是先進封裝領域的一項關鍵技術，應用於高效能晶片。
paras_en: On Monday (the 26th), U.S. semiconductor equipment maker Applied Materials (AMAT-US) announced plans to raise its stake in Dutch semiconductor equipment company BE Semiconductor Industries from the current 9% to about 20%, further deepening cooperation on advanced chip packaging technologies needed for artificial intelligence (AI) applications.

According to Reuters, Applied Materials said it has signed an accelerated share purchase agreement to increase its holding in the semiconductor equipment manufacturer, but the transaction is subject to U.S. antitrust review.
Since acquiring a 9% stake in BE Semiconductor in April 2025, Applied Materials has become the company’s largest shareholder.
With the expanded partnership, the two firms will focus on new chip interconnect and packaging technologies, aiming to support the next generation of AI semiconductors.
Applied Materials noted that it has no plans to raise its ownership beyond roughly 20% and does not intend to seek a seat on BE Semiconductor’s board of directors.
The two companies have been collaborating since 2020 on the development of hybrid bonding technology, a key advanced packaging technique used in high‑performance chips.

items.title: 特斯拉獲巴克萊升評股價看漲！分析師喊上看450美元 有望再漲20%
items.title_en: Barclays Upgrades Tesla to Buy, Targets $450; Analyst Says Could Rise Another 20%
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)本周一開始就有利多消息支撐，巴克萊(Barclays)分析師Dan Levy周一(26日)將特斯拉股票評等從「中立」上調至「買進」，並將目標價從370美元調高至450美元。
特斯拉與SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)近期證實，兩家公司的董事會正評估合併事宜。若兩家公司合併，將打造出一個AI產業巨頭，業務涵蓋基礎的AI模型，以及人形機器人等搭載AI的硬體產品。
Levy在報告中寫道：「市場高度預期兩家公司將合併，而且預期特斯拉股價可能獲得一定溢價，我們認為這將推動股價上漲。」
但這並非他轉趨看好特斯拉的唯一原因。Levy進一步解釋：「核心業務正展現改善趨勢，扭轉2024至2025年成長停滯的局面。」他指出，特斯拉汽車業務今年有望恢復成長，結束連續兩年的下滑，2027年也可望進一步改善，動能來自全自動輔助駕駛(Full Self-Driving，FSD)需求帶來的銷售，以及上海超級工廠出口增加。

FSD需求支撐銷量 獲利仍面臨壓力

特斯拉上周公布，FSD用戶數第3季末達174萬人，高於一年前的104萬人。此外，購買新款特斯拉的消費者中，約75%選擇每月支付99美元使用這項產品。
特斯拉今年來銷量較2025年同期增加約13%，但獲利表現並未同步改善，營業利益年減約30%，導致特斯拉股價今年來到周一開盤前下跌約17%。
投資人正等待特斯拉自駕計程車(Robotaxi)與機器人業務開始貢獻獲利，若特斯拉成為SpaceX的一部分，這些業務或許有機會實現投資人的期待。
根據FactSet，隨著巴克萊調升評等，目前追蹤特斯拉的分析師中，有49%給予「買進」評等。相較之下，標普500成分股獲得買進評等的分析師平均占比通常介於55%至60%。特斯拉分析師平均目標價約為415美元。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) has been buoyed by positive news since Monday, when Barclays analyst Dan Levy upgraded the stock from "Neutral" to "Buy" and raised the target price from $370 to $450.

Tesla and SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk recently confirmed that the boards of both companies are evaluating a merger. If combined, they would create an AI industry giant covering core AI models and hardware products such as humanoid robots equipped with AI.

Levy wrote in his report: "The market is strongly expecting a merger of the two companies, and anticipates that Tesla’s share price could command a premium. We believe this will drive the stock higher."

But that is not the only reason for his more bullish stance. Levy added: "The core business is showing an improving trend, reversing the growth stagnation expected for 2024‑2025." He noted that Tesla’s automotive segment is likely to return to growth this year, ending two consecutive years of decline, and could improve further by 2027, driven by Full Self‑Driving (FSD) demand and increased exports from the Shanghai Gigafactory.

FSD demand supports sales; profitability still under pressure. Tesla reported last week that the number of FSD users reached 1.74 million at the end of Q3, up from 1.04 million a year earlier. Moreover, about 75% of new‑car buyers opt to pay $99 per month for the feature.

Tesla’s sales this year are up roughly 13% versus the same period in 2025, but earnings have not kept pace, with operating profit down about 30% year‑over‑year, causing the stock to fall about 17% before Monday’s open.
Investors are waiting for Tesla’s robotaxi and robotics businesses to start contributing to earnings; if Tesla becomes part of SpaceX, those businesses may finally meet investors’ expectations.

According to FactSet, following Barclays’ upgrade, 49% of analysts covering Tesla now rate the stock as a "Buy." By comparison, analysts rate S&P 500 constituents as a buy about 55%‑60% of the time, and the average target price for Tesla analysts is roughly $415.

items.title: 川普痛批法官並誓言上訴 強調高爾夫球場改建計畫持續進行
items.title_en: Trump Slams Judge and Vows to Appeal, Emphasizes Golf Course Redevelopment Continues
paras: 美國總統川普誓言要對一名聯邦法官下達的命令提出上訴，這一命令限制他的一項宏大計畫——將華盛頓的一座市政高爾夫球場改造成錦標賽級球場。
周一(26日)深夜，川普在其「真實社群」(Truth Social)平台上發布了一篇長文，指出：「我們將按計畫於11月15日關閉東波托馬克(East Potomac)高爾夫球場，以便進行翻新和重建，使其達到競技標準(足以媲美其他同類項目！)法官根本無權阻撓這一舉措。」
當天早些時候，美國哥倫比亞特區聯邦地區法院法官Ana Reyes下令，禁止政府在高爾夫球場內砍伐更多樹木。
這一長達70頁的判決，延長阻止政府繼續砍伐樹木的禁制令，並要求行政部門若欲關閉球場或進行不可逆的改造，必須提前10個工作天通知法院。Reyes法官痛批政府無預警砍伐逾400棵樹木，「做了它曾向各界保證不會做的事」，並強調司法機關有權監督行政機關。
這座球場位於一座公園內，公園地帶向波托馬克河延伸，就在傑佛遜紀念堂的東南方，川普意圖改建的舉動，引發法律訴訟與在地民間團體的強烈反彈。
在結束密西西比州的一場期中選舉造勢集會並返回白宮後，川普向記者表示，東波托馬克計畫將繼續推進。在集會上，川普花了不少時間嘲諷那些批評他「重塑華盛頓」重大計畫的人，其中還包括前總統歐巴馬(Barack Obama)。
華盛頓地區自行車協會執行長Elizabeth Kiker強調，此園區是「該地區極其重要的生活基石」。每天在此跑步的馬里蘭州居民Ashley Hawkins指出，川普「剝奪公共綠地並試圖私有化，是他迄今最像國王行徑的舉措之一」。櫻花十哩路跑賽賽事總監Rob Wolfe警告，若環園道路遭廢除，「每天將有數以千計的人失去這片空間」。
華盛頓特區鳥類聯盟主席María-Elena Montero表示，關閉公園將帶來「棲地毀滅性的損失」，並重申「這片土地屬於人民」。在地民間組織「拯救東波托馬克」發起人Alex Rosen呼籲政府在缺乏公眾參與下，切勿擅自改變公園的核心本質。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump vowed to appeal a federal judge’s order that restricts his grand plan to convert a municipal golf course in Washington into a championship‑level venue.

Late Monday night (the 26th), Trump posted a lengthy message on his Truth Social platform, stating: “We will proceed as planned to close East Potomac Golf Course on November 15 for renovation and reconstruction to meet competitive standards (on par with other similar projects!). The judge has no authority to block this action.”
Earlier that day, U.S. District Judge Ana Reyes of the District of Columbia ordered a halt to any further tree cutting within the golf course.

The 70‑page ruling extends the injunction preventing the government from cutting more trees and requires the administration, if it wishes to close the course or undertake irreversible alterations, to give the court ten business days’ notice. Judge Reyes blasted the government for cutting over 400 trees without warning, saying it did what it had promised not to do, and underscored the judiciary’s right to oversee the executive.

The course sits inside a park that stretches toward the Potomac River just southeast of the Jefferson Memorial, and Trump’s proposed redevelopment has sparked lawsuits and fierce opposition from local community groups.

After finishing a mid‑term election rally in Mississippi and returning to the White House, Trump told reporters the East Potomac project would keep moving forward. At the rally he spent considerable time mocking critics of his “re‑shaping Washington” initiative, including former President Barack Obama.

Washington Area Bicycle Association executive director Elizabeth Kiker stressed that the park is “an essential cornerstone of life in the region.” Maryland resident Ashley Hawkins, who runs there daily, said Trump’s “stripping of public green space and attempt to privatize it is one of his most king‑like moves to date.” Cherry Blossom Ten‑Mile Run director Rob Wolfe warned that if the surrounding road network is eliminated, “thousands of people will lose this space every day.”

Washington, D.C. Bird Alliance chair María‑Elena Montero said closing the park would cause “catastrophic habitat loss,” reaffirming that “this land belongs to the people.” Alex Rosen, founder of the local group “Save East Potomac,” urged the government not to alter the park’s core character without public participation.

items.title: SemiAnalysis創辦人點出AI瓶頸的真實排序！基板>記憶體>光學>電力
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis Founder Highlights the True Order of AI Bottlenecks: Substrates>Memory>Optics>Power
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設持續擴張，市場普遍將電力視為資料中心建置的主要瓶頸，但 SemiAnalysis 創辦人 Dylan Patel 提出不同看法。他指出，AI 供應鏈真正的瓶頸依序為封裝基板、記憶體、光學互連與電力，其中基板供應不足的問題最為嚴重，未來兩年恐限制 AI 加速器、中央處理器（CPU）及其他關鍵零組件的產能。
根據華美半導體協會（CASPA）10 月 23 日在美國舉行的第 35 屆年會 CEO 峰會內容，Patel 與 Bernstein 半導體首席分析師 Stacy Rasgon 討論 AI 基礎建設的供應限制、記憶體價格走勢，以及半導體產業未來的競爭格局。
Patel 認為，市場對電力短缺的關注可能過高，半導體供應鏈的擴產難度，才是限制 AI 基建持續成長的關鍵。

封裝基板供應不足成最大瓶頸

Patel 指出，除記憶體外，封裝基板、印刷電路板（PCB）材料及其他基板材料，是目前半導體供應鏈面臨的最大限制。相關產業長期投資不足，加上部分材料供應商位於日本，擴產態度相對保守，使供應難以迅速跟上 AI 需求。
他表示，未來兩年，AI 加速器、CPU 及各類電子元件都可能受到基板供應不足影響，這項瓶頸甚至比土地、電力、資料中心機房與半導體設備更為嚴重。
除了基板，記憶體也是 AI 基建擴張的重要限制。Rasgon 指出，高頻寬記憶體（HBM）的生產會大量消耗晶圓產能，生產相同容量的 HBM，所需晶圓量約為一般 DDR5 記憶體的三至四倍，進一步排擠標準記憶體的生產資源。
隨著 AI 晶片對 HBM 的需求持續增加，記憶體供應緊張也可能延伸至其他產品，影響整體半導體產業的產能配置。

光學互連擴產困難 電力反而有替代方案

在供應瓶頸排序中，Patel 將光學互連列在記憶體之後。他指出，產業正積極擴大光學互連產能，包括共封裝光學（CPO）及近封裝光學等技術，但相關供應鏈仍難以快速擴張。
即使到了 2028 年，若大型業者都希望導入 CPO，雷射與光纖耦合等關鍵元件的供應，仍可能無法滿足任何一家大型業者的需求，成為 AI 基礎建設持續擴張的另一項限制。
相較之下，Patel 認為，電力雖然仍是 AI 資料中心的重要瓶頸，但業者已有多種替代方案，包括在現場設置燃氣輪機、往復式引擎與燃料電池，以補足電力需求。
他指出，電力供應能力可以在相對較短的時間內提升，整體建置複雜度也遠低於半導體供應鏈，因此電力問題雖然受到市場高度關注，卻未必是目前最難突破的限制。
Patel 的研究估計，明年全球預計將有接近 50 吉瓦的資料中心投入運作，其中美國約占 35 吉瓦，中國約占 7 至 8 吉瓦，其餘分布於澳洲、印度及馬來西亞等地。

記憶體與設備供應吃緊恐延續至2028年

Rasgon 指出，記憶體市場目前呈現特殊情況，相關企業的遠期本益比僅約兩至四倍，反映投資人擔憂記憶體價格已處於周期高點，並預期 2028 年新增產能投產後，市場可能出現價格下跌。
不過，他也提出另一種可能性：如果新產能釋出後，記憶體價格並未如市場預期般崩跌，產業的高獲利表現可能持續更長時間。
他進一步指出，半導體設備市場的擴張同樣受到限制。應用材料(AMAT-US) 近期對明年晶圓製造設備（WFE）市場規模提出初步展望，預估將超過 2,000 億美元，但 Rasgon 認為，進一步成長仍受到晶圓廠數量與無塵室空間限制。
今年設備支出增加，主要是業者在既有廠房內提高產能利用率；新建晶圓廠則需要數年時間，預計部分無塵室空間將於 2027 年陸續投入使用，並在 2028 至 2029 年進一步擴大產能。
此外，設備製造商本身也受到 PCB、半導體晶片、閥門及質量流量控制器等零組件供應不足影響，顯示供應鏈瓶頸並不限於最終產品，而是可能一路延伸至上游製造環節。
Rasgon 預期，半導體供應緊張情況今年與明年都將持續，2028 年也很可能仍然吃緊；到了 2029 年，產業面臨的問題才可能逐漸轉向需求端。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure continues to expand, and the market generally sees power as the main bottleneck for data‑center construction, but SemiAnalysis founder Dylan Patel offers a different view. He points out that the real bottlenecks in the AI supply chain are, in order, packaging substrates, memory, optical interconnects and power, with substrate shortages being the most severe and likely to limit the capacity of AI accelerators, central processing units (CPUs) and other key components over the next two years.

According to the 35th annual CASPA (China America Semiconductor Partnership Association) CEO summit held in the United States on October 23, Patel discussed AI infrastructure supply constraints, memory price trends, and the future competitive landscape of the semiconductor industry with Bernstein Semiconductor senior analyst Stacy Rasgon.
Patel believes the market may be over‑emphasizing power shortages; the difficulty of expanding semiconductor production capacity is the real factor limiting continued AI infrastructure growth.

Insufficient substrate supply is the biggest bottleneck. Patel notes that aside from memory, packaging substrates, printed circuit board (PCB) materials and other substrate materials represent the greatest constraints in the semiconductor supply chain. Long‑term under‑investment in these industries, combined with many material suppliers being based in Japan and taking a cautious expansion stance, makes it hard for supply to keep pace with AI demand.

He says that over the next two years AI accelerators, CPUs and various electronic components could all be affected by substrate shortages, a bottleneck that may be even more serious than land, power, data‑center facilities or semiconductor equipment.

Beyond substrates, memory is also a key limitation for AI infrastructure expansion. Rasgon points out that producing high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) consumes a large share of wafer capacity—manufacturing the same capacity of HBM requires roughly three to four times the wafers needed for standard DDR5 memory—further crowding out resources for conventional memory production.
As AI chips’ demand for HBM continues to rise, tight memory supply could spill over to other products, affecting overall semiconductor capacity allocation.

Optical interconnect expansion is difficult, while power has alternative solutions. In his bottleneck ranking, Patel places optical interconnects after memory. He notes the industry is actively expanding optical interconnect capacity, including co‑packaged optics (CPO) and near‑package optics, but the related supply chain still cannot scale quickly.

Even by 2028, if large players all aim to adopt CPO, the supply of key components such as lasers and fiber couplers may still fall short of any single major vendor’s needs, becoming another constraint on AI infrastructure growth.

In contrast, Patel argues that although power remains an important bottleneck for AI data centers, operators already have several workarounds, such as on‑site gas turbines, reciprocating engines and fuel cells to supplement electricity needs.

He points out that power capacity can be boosted relatively quickly and the overall deployment complexity is far lower than that of the semiconductor supply chain, so despite high market attention, power may not be the hardest barrier to overcome right now.

Patel’s research estimates that next year roughly 50 GW of data‑center capacity will come online globally, with about 35 GW in the United States, 7‑8 GW in China, and the remainder spread across Australia, India and Malaysia.

Memory and equipment supply tightness could persist through 2028. Rasgon notes the memory market is in a unique situation, with forward price‑to‑earnings multiples of only about two to four times, reflecting investor worries that memory prices are at a cyclical peak and that prices may fall after new capacity comes online in 2028.
He also raises another scenario: if new capacity does not trigger the expected price collapse, the industry’s high profitability could continue for a longer period.

He further observes that the semiconductor equipment market’s expansion is also constrained. Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) recently offered a preliminary outlook for next year’s wafer‑fab equipment (WFE) market, projecting it to exceed $200 billion, but Rasgon believes further growth will still be limited by the number of fabs and clean‑room space.

This year’s equipment spending increase is mainly due to operators raising capacity utilization in existing plants; building new fabs takes several years, with some clean‑room space expected to come online gradually in 2027 and further capacity expansion in 2028‑2029.

In addition, equipment manufacturers themselves face shortages of components such as PCBs, semiconductor chips, valves and mass‑flow controllers, showing that supply‑chain bottlenecks extend beyond finished products to upstream manufacturing stages.

Rasgon expects semiconductor supply tightness to continue through this year and next, likely remaining constrained in 2028; only by 2029 might the industry’s challenges start shifting toward the demand side.

items.title: 〈財報〉國防業務成長也難補！波音Q3商用飛機虧損超預期 增產還卡關
items.title_en: Earnings: Defense Growth Still Can't Fill the Gap! Boeing Q3 Commercial Aircraft Losses Exceed Expectations, Production Ramp‑Up Stalled
paras: 波音(BA-US)周二(27日)美股盤前公布2026會計年度第三季(截至9/30)財報，國防業務成長帶動整體虧損較去年大幅收斂，營收與自由現金流也優於預期，但商用飛機交付幾乎停滯，加上增產與供應鏈成本攀升，導致核心商用飛機部門虧損超出預期，凸顯這家航太巨擘的復甦之路仍面臨挑戰。
截稿前，波音周二盤前股價小漲0.37%，每股暫報189美元，稍早一度上漲1.4%。該股今年以來累計下跌約13%，若此走勢延續至年底，全年表現將是近5年來次差。
根據財報，波音第三季營收年增4%至241.9億美元，高於市場預估的238.4億美元；淨損1.16億美元，每股虧損0.26美元，較去年同期淨損53.4億美元明顯改善。不過，調整後每股虧損0.34美元，仍遜於分析師預估的虧損0.21美元。
去年同期波音曾因延宕的777X計畫認列約49億美元費用，使虧損基期偏高。本季自由現金流則達4.64億美元，高於去年同期的2.38億美元，也超過市場預估的3.251億美元。

商用飛機虧損超標 增產仍受阻

波音第三季交付161架商用飛機，僅比去年同期多1架。商用飛機部門營收年減3%至107.2億美元，營業虧損6.97億美元，遠高於分析師預估的3.608億美元，營業利益率為負6.5%。
公司表示，交付機型組合較不利、未來調整產能所需的預估成本提高，以及供應鏈成本增加，均拖累部門表現。
波音仍努力讓737 MAX月產量穩定在47架，增產進度慢於預期，機翼製造與引擎供應都是限制因素。787目前月產約8架，公司先前也坦言，引擎交付尚不足以支撐月產10架的目標。
飛機交付是改善財務的關鍵，因為客戶通常在收機時支付大部分款項。波音重申，預計明年開始交付777-9，較原定時程晚約6年，並計劃明年進一步提高737 MAX產量。

國防業務支撐復甦 債務壓力仍在

國防與太空部門第三季營收年增15%至79.4億美元，受惠全球國防支出增加帶動交付成長，加上營運改善及出售共同持有逾20年的HRL Laboratories所帶來的助益，營業獲利接近5億美元，營業利益率由去年同期的1.7%升至6.2%。全球服務部門營業獲利則達10億美元。
波音近期也取得進展，包括拿下美國海軍第六代F/A-XX戰機合約，以及737 MAX 7、MAX 10陸續獲美國監管機關認證。
季末總債務維持459億美元，淨債務則由前季259億美元降至252億美元，另有100億美元未動用授信額度。
執行長奧特伯格(Kelly Ortberg)表示，公司基礎比一年前更穩固，但仍須改善效率、落實訂單交付，並在維持安全與品質的同時提升日常營運表現。
paras_en: Boeing (BA-US) on Tuesday (the 27th) released its fiscal 2026 third‑quarter earnings (ended September 30) before the U.S. market opened. Growth in the defense segment helped narrow the overall loss sharply versus last year, and revenue and free cash flow beat forecasts, but commercial‑aircraft deliveries were almost flat. Rising production costs and supply‑chain expenses pushed the core commercial‑aircraft division’s loss beyond expectations, underscoring that the aerospace giant’s recovery path still faces hurdles.

Ahead of the market close on Tuesday, Boeing’s pre‑market share rose modestly 0.37% to $189 per share after briefly climbing 1.4% earlier. The stock is down about 13% year‑to‑date; if that trend continues through year‑end, its annual performance would be the worst in nearly five years.

According to the filing, Boeing’s third‑quarter revenue grew 4% year‑over‑year to $24.19 billion, topping analysts’ estimate of $23.84 billion. Net loss was $1.16 billion, or $0.26 per share, a marked improvement from the $5.34 billion loss a year earlier. However, adjusted loss per share was $0.34, still worse than the consensus forecast of a $0.21 loss.

Last year Boeing booked roughly $4.9 billion of charges tied to delays in the 777X program, inflating the prior‑year loss base. This quarter’s free cash flow reached $464 million, up from $238 million a year earlier and above the $325.1 million analysts expected.

Commercial‑aircraft losses blew past expectations and production gains remain constrained. Boeing delivered 161 commercial jets in the quarter, just one more than the same period last year. Commercial‑aircraft revenue fell 3% to $10.72 billion, while operating loss widened to $697 million, far exceeding analysts’ $360.8 million estimate, and operating margin turned negative 6.5%.
The company said an unfavorable mix of delivered models, higher estimated costs to adjust capacity, and rising supply‑chain expenses all weighed on the segment’s performance.

Boeing is still working to keep 737 MAX monthly output steady at 47 aircraft, but the ramp‑up is slower than hoped, with wing‑building and engine supply acting as bottlenecks. The 787 is currently produced at about eight units per month, and the firm has previously admitted that engine deliveries are insufficient to support a target of ten per month.

Aircraft deliveries are key to improving finances because customers typically pay most of the price upon receipt. Boeing reiterated that it expects to start delivering the 777‑9 next year, roughly six years later than originally planned, and it aims to further increase 737 MAX output next year.

Defense and space revenue rose 15% year‑over‑year to $7.94 billion, helped by higher global defense spending and stronger delivery growth, as well as operational improvements and proceeds from the sale of its more‑than‑20‑year‑held stake in HRL Laboratories. Operating profit approached $500 million, with operating margin climbing from 1.7% a year ago to 6.2%. Global services generated $1 billion in operating profit.
Boeing has also made recent strides, securing a U.S. Navy sixth‑generation F/A‑XX fighter contract and obtaining U.S. regulator approvals for the 737 MAX 7 and MAX 10 variants.
Quarter‑end total debt stayed at $45.9 billion, while net debt fell from $25.9 billion in the prior quarter to $25.2 billion, and $10 billion of credit remains undrawn.

CEO Kelly Ortberg said the company’s foundation is stronger than a year ago, but it still needs to boost efficiency, execute order deliveries, and improve day‑to‑day operations while maintaining safety and quality.

items.title: 〈台幣〉爆量轉升5.6分收32.452元 央行估聯準會年底再升息1碼
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Surges on Heavy Volume, Gains 5.6 ¢ to Close at 32.452 per USD; Central Bank Says Fed May Raise Rates by One More 0.25 % Point by Year‑End
paras: 新台幣今(27)日升貶互見，午盤過後爆量偏強反彈，終場兌一美元以32.452元作收，升值5.6分，台北外匯經紀公司再度擴大至27.33億美元；中央銀行在今日下午最新出爐的書面報告中提到，今年以來至10月21日外資淨匯出達776億美元，而聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼。
新台幣今日以32.53元、貶值2.2分開出後，一度貶至32.604元，午盤過後則扭轉弱勢，轉為成交爆量彈升，光是下午盤成交量就高達16.06億美元，最高來到32.452元，全日高低價差1.52角。
觀察主要亞幣，漲跌互見，日元逆勢走貶超過0.2%，韓元、新元和泰銖均貶約0.05%，反觀新台幣收升0.17%，美元指數則反彈近0.2%。
央行總裁楊金龍在今日出爐的業務報告也提到，上半年新台幣對美元貶值1.25%，主要是因國內匯市出現美元超額需求，外資淨匯出233億美元，使央行累計淨賣匯170.4億美元(約當GDP的-1.62%)，以維持國內匯市穩定。
而下半年以來，地緣政治風險導致美元避險需求升溫，加上聯準會9月升息1碼，使外資繼續淨匯出543億美元，新台幣貶值2%；累計今年以來新台幣貶值3.25%，外資淨匯出776億美元。
央行認為，聯準會年底前可能再升息1碼，支撐國際美元走勢，新台幣對美元匯率貶值。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar showed mixed movement today (27th), but after the midday session it rebounded strongly on heavy volume, closing at NT$32.452 per US$1, a gain of 5.6 ¢. Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanded their net buying to US$27.33 billion; the central bank’s latest written report this afternoon noted that net foreign‑capital outflows have reached US$77.6 billion up to October 21, and the Federal Reserve may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before year‑end.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$32.53, down 2.2 ¢, and fell to as low as NT$32.604. After the midday session it reversed the weakness, snapping up on a volume surge – the afternoon session alone saw US$16.06 billion traded, pushing the rate up to a high of NT$32.452. The intraday range was 1.52 ¢.

Among the major Asian currencies, movements were mixed: the Japanese yen fell more than 0.2% against the dollar, while the Korean won, Singapore dollar and Thai baht each slipped about 0.05%. In contrast, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.17%, and the US dollar index rebounded roughly 0.2%.

Central Bank Governor Yang Jin‑long noted in today’s business report that the New Taiwan dollar depreciated 1.25% against the US dollar in the first half of the year, mainly due to excess domestic demand for dollars. Net foreign outflows of US$23.3 billion forced the bank to sell a cumulative US$17.04 billion of foreign exchange (about –1.62% of GDP) to keep the local FX market stable.

In the second half of the year, heightened geopolitical risk boosted safe‑haven demand for the dollar, and the Fed’s 0.25 percentage‑point rate hike in September prompted foreign investors to net outflow another US$54.3 billion, pushing the New Taiwan dollar down another 2%. Overall, the New Taiwan dollar has weakened 3.25% year‑to‑date, with total foreign outflows reaching US$77.6 billion.

The central bank believes the Fed may raise rates by another 0.25 percentage point before the end of the year, supporting the international dollar’s strength and keeping the New Taiwan dollar’s exchange rate on a depreciation trend.

上周密西根大學消費者調查美國10月消費者信心指數創紀錄第二低達48.0，而且標準普爾(S&P)全球公布美國10月綜合採購經理人指數(PMI)產出指數初值降至57.6，令美元承壓；此外，與人工智慧(AI)相關股票遭拋售引發避險需求升溫，推動日本公債收益率走高，並據上週五日本數據顯示9月核心消費者通貨膨脹率九個月來首次超過日本央行(BOJ)的2%目標，表明價格上漲壓力加大，強化BOJ短期內升息的理由，而且本周迎來一系列央行會議和企業財務報告，帶動資金流入日圓，週一推低美元兌日圓至156.63低點。

據市場普遍預期BOJ將在本周會議維持利率1.25%不變，並採取鷹派暫停策略，為12月加息留出空間，料升息的機率為61%，但美國9月全國活動指數為0.07及達拉斯聯邦儲備銀行10月製造業指數為13.4皆高於前值，並據芝加哥商業交易所（CME）的FedWatch工具，市場認為美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)在12月加息的概率為80%，而且主要產油國沙烏地阿拉伯及海上航運持續遭襲擊，導致油價仍接近六個月高位，推升美元兌日圓至157.64高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於156.90-157.10，阻力於157.80-158.00。
◆EUR/USD
昨日路透調查多數經濟學家預測紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)週三將實施今年第三次升息，市場完全消化RBNZ加息25個基點，同時等待澳洲通貨膨脹數據週三出爐，可能決定澳洲央行(RBA)近期是否升息，支撐紐元及澳幣，而且法國社會動盪及財政捉襟見肘，但評級機構穆迪未下調該國信用評級，使法國公債拋售暫歇，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1226高點。

隨後伊福經濟研究所(Ifo)表示，德國10月企業景氣判斷指數升至90.2高於預期，但歐洲央行(ECB)調查顯示，因燃料價格上漲和成本攀升影響財務，歐元區企業從銀行獲得信貸的難度升高，而且法國抗議團體和工會呼籲10月31日舉行進一步示威，並發動11月5日全國大罷工，力圖繼續向政府施壓，社會動盪未息及預算問題惡化的擔憂打擊歐元，而且高油價對依賴能源進口的歐元區經濟構成壓力，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1172低點價位。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1175-95，支撐於1.1090-1.1110。
◆GBP/USD

據泰晤士報報導，英國財政大臣希利預計宣布國家養老金上調3.9%，而且英國首相伯納姆週一表示短期內不會舉行大選，並稱目前專注於施政，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3387高點。隨後英國工業聯盟(CBI)公布月度零售銷售差值從10月的五個月低點負55升至11月的負10，達去年4月以來最高，與近期其他數數反映的低迷趨勢形成對比，但路透調查，本週三英國預算案後，今年政府的發債規模僅小幅增加，可是未來借貸規模將繼續攀升，而且本周市場關注英國預算案，並有FED、ECB及BOJ貨幣政策決議，交投趨謹慎，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3324低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3350-70，支撐於1.3260-80。

paras_en: USD/JPY

Last week the University of Michigan consumer survey showed the U.S. October consumer confidence index fell to a record low of 48.0, and S&P Global reported the preliminary October U.S. composite PMI output index at 57.6, putting pressure on the dollar. In addition, AI‑related stocks were sold off, boosting safe‑haven demand, pushing Japanese government bond yields higher. September core CPI in Japan rose above the Bank of Japan’s 2% target for the first time in nine months, indicating rising price pressure and strengthening the case for a short‑term rate hike. A series of central‑bank meetings and corporate earnings this week attracted inflows into the yen, pulling the USD/JPY down to a low of 156.63 on Monday.

The market broadly expects the BOJ to keep its policy rate at 1.25% this week and adopt a hawkish pause to leave room for a December hike, with a 61% probability of a rate increase. However, U.S. September national activity index was 0.07 and the Dallas Fed’s October manufacturing index was 13.4, both above prior levels. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market sees an 80% chance of a Fed hike in December. Meanwhile, ongoing attacks on Saudi Arabia and maritime shipping keep oil prices near six‑month highs, lifting USD/JPY to a high of 157.64. Today’s USD/JPY is expected to find support at 156.90‑157.10 and resistance at 157.80‑158.00.
EUR/USD

A Reuters poll of economists found most expect the Reserve Bank of New Zealand to implement its third rate hike of the year on Wednesday, with the market fully pricing in a 25‑basis‑point increase. Traders are also awaiting Australian inflation data on Wednesday, which could influence the Reserve Bank of Australia’s near‑term rate path, supporting the NZD and AUD. Despite social unrest and fiscal strain in France, Moody’s has not downgraded the country’s credit rating, pausing French bond selling and helping the euro reach a high of 1.1226 against the dollar.

Subsequently, the Ifo Institute reported Germany’s October business climate index rose to 90.2, above expectations. Yet an ECB survey showed that higher fuel prices and rising costs are making credit harder to obtain for euro‑area firms. French protest groups and unions have called for further demonstrations on Oct. 31 and a nationwide strike on Nov. 5, keeping social unrest and budget worries alive, which weighs on the euro. High oil prices also pressure the energy‑import‑dependent eurozone economy, pushing EUR/USD down to a low of 1.1172. Today’s EUR/USD resistance is projected at 1.1175‑1.1195 and support at 1.1090‑1.1110.
GBP/USD

According to the Times, UK Chancellor Jeremy Hunt is expected to announce a 3.9% increase in the state pension, and Prime Minister Rishi Sunak said on Monday that there will be no election in the short term, focusing on governance, which lifted the pound to a high of 1.3387 against the dollar. Later, the CBI reported the monthly retail sales gap improved from a five‑month low of –55 in October to –10 in November, the best since April last year, contrasting with other weak indicators. Reuters noted that after this week’s budget, the government’s borrowing will only rise modestly, but future borrowing is set to keep climbing. With the budget, plus Fed, ECB and BOJ policy decisions this week, market sentiment is cautious, pulling the pound down to a low of 1.3324. Today’s GBP/USD resistance is around 1.3350‑1.3370 and support at 1.3260‑1.3280.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Euro Weakens Ahead of Central Bank Meetings, Brazilian Real Plummets
paras: 美元周一(26日)上漲， 在各國央行即將召開一連串重要會議之際，歐元兌美元匯率下跌，同時原油價格持續處於高檔。另一方面，巴西總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）意外勝選後，巴西雷亞爾大幅貶值。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週由於法國政府公債遭到拋售，法國的債務風險溢酬升至自 2011 年歐洲主權債務危機以來最高，再度引發市場對歐元區可能重陷金融壓力的擔憂，歐元因此承壓。
不過，穆迪（Moody’s）上週並未調降法國的信用評等，緩解了市場部分疑慮。週一，法國政府公債（OAT）價格因此上漲，讓這個正努力改善財政困境的政府稍稍鬆了一口氣。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.21%，至每歐元 1.1179 美元。但歐元兌日元上漲 0.31%，至每歐元 176.04 日元。
法國興業銀行（Société Générale）首席外匯策略師Kit Juckes表示，「歐元面臨的基本問題並沒有改變，而且各國公債利差已經收窄。歐元目前仍容易受到衝擊，因為經濟成長前景不佳，能源價格也依然居高不下。」
布蘭特原油期貨價格雖然小幅回落，但仍維持在近六個月高點附近。油價高漲會對歐元區等仰賴能源進口的經濟體造成壓力。布蘭特原油下跌 0.78%，收於每桶 115.81 美元。
儘管美國面臨通膨上升等不利因素，但穩健的經濟數據仍為美元提供支撐。上週在科技股領跌的市場賣壓中，美元也曾面臨拋售壓力。
本週稍晚，五家主要央行將公布貨幣政策決策。市場預期，美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）都將維持利率不變，儘管通膨壓力依然存在。
紐西蘭與加拿大的央行則預計將在本週升息。
日元兌美元下跌 0.43%，至每美元 157.46 日元。
Juckes表示，「美元的表現沒有預期中那麼強勢，也面臨一些不利因素，但美國經濟數據一直相當穩健。」
巴西雷亞爾大幅下挫
巴西總統魯拉於週日勝選，取得歷史性的第四個任期。面對前總統波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）長子、參議員Flávio Bolsonaro，魯拉贏得選舉，巴西雷亞爾兌美元匯率隨即大幅下跌。
Bolsonaro在第一輪投票中領先，但在第二輪決選中以超過 400 萬票的差距落敗，震撼了原本押注他會勝選的巴西金融市場。
Bolsonaro拒絕承認敗選，並承諾將要求撤銷選舉結果。
高盛分析師團隊由Teresa Alves領銜，他們在提供投資人的研究報告中表示，「選舉結果若遭到更長時間的爭議，將對市場情緒產生負面影響。更根本的問題是，我們認為巴西雷亞爾及其他當地資產應反映更高的財政風險溢酬，尤其是近幾週政府已大幅放寬財政政策。」
分析師進一步指出，「在先前針對較差財政結果所進行的美元兌雷亞爾匯率評估中，我們認為 5.40 的匯率水準，相當於 2024 年 9 月市場所反映的財政風險溢酬；當時政府尚未在同年 11 月宣布額外的財政措施。至於 5.80 的水準，則代表更高程度的財政風險溢酬，類似於 2024 年 12 月的情況。」
巴西雷亞爾兌美元大幅下跌 8.5%，來到每美元兌 5.4 雷亞爾。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Monday (the 26th) as a series of important central‑bank meetings loom, the euro fell against the dollar, and oil prices remained high. Meanwhile, the Brazilian real sharply depreciated after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s unexpected election victory.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.

Last week, French sovereign bonds were sold off, pushing France’s debt risk premium to its highest level since the 2011 European sovereign debt crisis, reviving market worries that the euro area could once again face financial pressure, and the euro came under strain.

However, Moody’s did not downgrade France’s credit rating last week, easing some market concerns. On Monday, French OAT prices rose, giving the government, which is working to improve its fiscal situation, a slight sigh of relief.
The euro fell 0.21% to $1.1179, while the euro gained 0.31% against the yen, reaching ¥176.04 per euro.

Société Générale chief FX strategist Kit Juckes said, “The euro’s fundamental problems have not changed, and sovereign‑bond spreads have narrowed. The euro remains vulnerable because growth prospects are weak and energy prices stay high.”
Brent crude futures slipped slightly but stayed near six‑month highs. High oil prices pressure economies that rely on energy imports, such as the euro area. Brent fell 0.78% to $115.81 a barrel.

Despite adverse factors like rising inflation in the United States, solid economic data continue to support the dollar. Last week, amid market selling led by tech stocks, the dollar also faced selling pressure.

Later this week, five major central banks will announce policy decisions. Markets expect the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan to keep rates unchanged, even though inflation pressures persist.
The Reserve Banks of New Zealand and Canada are expected to raise rates this week.
The yen slipped 0.43% to ¥157.46 per dollar.
Juckes added, “The dollar’s performance is not as strong as expected and faces some headwinds, but U.S. economic data have remained quite robust.”
Brazilian real plunges
President Lula won a historic fourth term on Sunday. After defeating former President Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the real immediately fell sharply against the dollar.
Bolsonaro led in the first round but lost the runoff by more than four million votes, shocking Brazilian financial markets that had bet on his victory.
Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat and says he will seek to overturn the election results.

Goldman Sachs analysts led by Teresa Alves wrote in a research note that “If the election outcome remains contested for a longer period, market sentiment will suffer. More fundamentally, we believe the real and other local assets should reflect a higher fiscal‑risk premium, especially as the government has recently relaxed fiscal policy dramatically.”

The analysts further noted, “In our earlier USD/BRL valuation based on poorer fiscal outcomes, we considered a rate of 5.40 as reflecting the fiscal‑risk premium priced by the market in September 2024, before the government announced additional fiscal measures in November. A level of 5.80 would imply an even higher fiscal‑risk premium, similar to the situation in December 2024.”
The Brazilian real fell 8.5% against the dollar, reaching 5.4 reais per dollar.

items.title: 十月累漲4.6%！瑞士股市成為市場AI恐慌下的避風港
items.title_en: October Up 4.6%: Swiss Market Becomes a Safe Haven Amid AI Panic
paras: 瑞士股指本月迄今累計上漲4.6%，而歐元區大盤指數歐洲Stoxx 50同期跌幅則達3.2%，兩者近8個百分點的超額收益創2020年3月以來最高。這一反差背後是歐洲投資人在融資成本走高、AI交易遇冷及法西政局動盪之際，主動降低風險敞口，轉向防禦資產。
上漲幾乎全由三大權重股拉動：羅氏漲12%、諾華漲6.7%、雀巢漲10%，這三檔老牌防禦龍頭貢獻指數全部漲幅，合計佔指數近半權重。
EFG資產管理指出，資金正從擁擠的AI交易撤出，回流獲利紮實、對利率敏感度低的醫藥與食品部門。美銀調查也顯示，淨16%的基金經理人最看好瑞士股市。
支撐行情的還有獲利預期改善。根據《彭博資訊》數據顯示，成分企業2027年獲利成長預期上升至10%，幾乎今年兩倍。
瑞士知名私人銀行薩夫拉薩辛銀行策略師Wolf von Rotberg上調評級至「跑贏大盤」，稱利率、美元及宏觀週期見頂三大因素均利好瑞士市場。
但估值隱憂浮現。經過一輪急漲，瑞士股指相對Stoxx 50的比價重回近兩年高位，估值偏貴限制上行空間。
此外，瑞士法郎本月因避險需求反彈，恐擾動出口導向大盤股獲利。市場正權衡防禦屬性與高估值壓力，修復行情能否延續仍待觀察。
paras_en: Swiss equities have risen 4.6% so far this month, while the Euro‑zone’s broad Stoxx 50 index has fallen 3.2% over the same period, delivering an excess return of nearly eight percentage points – the widest gap since March 2020. The divergence reflects European investors trimming risk exposure as financing costs rise, AI‑driven trading cools, and political turmoil spikes, prompting a shift toward defensive assets.

The gains are almost entirely driven by three heavyweight stocks: Roche up 12%, Novartis up 6.7% and Nestlé up 10%. These three long‑standing defensive leaders account for almost half of the index’s weight and contributed the full upside of the index.

EFG Asset Management notes that capital is flowing out of crowded AI trades and back into solid‑earning, low‑rate‑sensitivity sectors such as pharmaceuticals and food. A Bank of America survey also shows that a net 16% of fund managers are most bullish on Swiss equities.

The rally is also supported by improving earnings expectations. Bloomberg data indicate that the component companies’ profit‑growth outlook for 2027 has risen to 10%, roughly double the forecast made earlier this year.

Wolf von Rotberg, a strategist at Swiss private bank Safra Sarasin, upgraded his rating to “outperform,” saying that peaking interest rates, a strong dollar and a top‑of‑the‑cycle macro environment are all favorable for the Swiss market.

However, valuation concerns are emerging. After a sharp rally, the Swiss index’s price‑to‑Stoxx 50 multiple has returned to near‑two‑year highs, making the market look expensive and capping further upside potential.

In addition, the Swiss franc has rebounded this month on safe‑haven demand, which could hurt profit margins of export‑oriented large‑cap stocks. The market is weighing defensive appeal against overvaluation pressure, and it remains to be seen whether the rally can be sustained.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。
交易員目前預估，日本銀行12月升息的機率為61%。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 日元走強 油價、AI與法國局勢引發市場不安
items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。
歐元兌美元下跌0.09%，至1.1222美元。法國社會動盪的疑慮，以及該國財政前景惡化的問題，影響力超過了AI交易的擔憂，後者則拖累美國股市走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報101.60。
Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”
